subtitle: Cross-check of 05/Oct/2026, first update of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections, generated at 12:51 on 05/Oct), the nine national polls released on 03/Oct and the press flow of 04 and 05/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 16.50% (vol USD 17.91M cumulative) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, up 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Oct at 21:43 BRT, published on the night of the count. COUNT: 45.16% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), 1.87 points behind. POLL: on the eve, he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in three of the nine national polls of 03/Oct and was tied in one.
fortes: On the eve he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, 47% to 46%, in CNT/MDA, 47.3% to 43.1%, and in AtlasIntel, 47.6% to 47.4%, and was tied at 46% in PoderData.
🏆 Counting the closed contracts, his contract is now the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 17.91M.
fracos: He stands at 16.50% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over him is 66.60pp.
He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 45.16% of the valid votes against 47.03%.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula stands at 16.50% in the winner contract (vol USD 17.91M cumulative), confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, and rises 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Oct at 21:43 BRT, published on the night of the count. 🗳️ He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 45.16% of the valid votes, 1.87 points behind Flávio Bolsonaro, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and the two face off in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) on 25/Oct. On the eve of the first round the second round was split: Lula ahead in Datafolha (47% to 46%), in CNT/MDA (47.3% to 43.1%) and in AtlasIntel (47.6% to 47.4%), a tie at 46% in PoderData, and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) (44% to 42%), in Palver (49% to 44%), in Futura (48% to 45.1%) and in Gerp (49% to 44%). The first national polls after the first round are registered with the TSE for 08/Oct (Datafolha and PoderData) and 09/Oct (AtlasIntel and Vox Brasil). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the result or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 83.10% (vol USD 16.98M cumulative) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, down 1.15pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Oct at 21:43 BRT, published on the night of the count. COUNT: 47.03% of the valid votes in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), 1.87 points ahead. POLL: on the eve, he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the nine national polls of 03/Oct.
fortes: He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) ahead, with 47.03% of the valid votes against Lula's 45.16%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally.
He stands at 83.10% in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT.
On the eve he led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), 44% to 42%, in Palver, 49% to 44%, in Futura, 48% to 45.1%, and in Gerp, 49% to 44%.

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, second-round vote transfer favoured Flávio Bolsonaro among the voters of Romeu Zema (81%), Renan Santos (48%), Ronaldo Caiado (42%) and Augusto Cury (34%) (O Globo).
fracos: On the eve he trailed in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, CNT/MDA and AtlasIntel, and was tied in PoderData.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro's arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 83.10% in the winner contract (vol USD 16.98M cumulative), confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, and falls 1.15pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Oct at 21:43 BRT, published on the night of the count. 🗳️ He finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 47.03% of the valid votes, 1.87 points ahead of Lula, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. 🤝 União Brasil and PP signal support for him, with a decision in the coming days (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo), and Ronaldo Caiado promised to announce his endorsement on Tuesday, 06/Oct, in Goiânia (Metrópoles and O Globo). The first national polls after the first round are registered with the TSE for 08/Oct (Datafolha and PoderData) and 09/Oct (AtlasIntel and Vox Brasil). ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the result or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): third place, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): according to Agência Brasil, he talks of staying silent.
fortes: He finished third, with 2.89% of the valid votes, ahead of Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado.
The [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno)'s third-place book was resolved in his favour.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid more for Renan Santos, 47.50%, and for Ronaldo Caiado, 30.00%, than for him, 23.70%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in third, with 2.89% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 5.51M cumulative. The first round's third-place book, which on the eve paid 23.70% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, was resolved in his favour. 🤝 According to Agência Brasil, he talks of staying silent in the second round; the report has a single source and is included with attribution.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): fourth place, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. PRICE: winner contract closed and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative. [SECOND ROUND](/en/glossary#segundo-turno): he backs neither of the two.
fortes: He finished fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%.
His contract in the winner book closed with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book.
fracos: He is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and his contract in the winner book was resolved at zero.
On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, and third place went to Augusto Cury.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fourth, with 2.24% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally, and is out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). His contract in the winner book was closed by Polymarket after the first round and resolved at zero, with USD 17.12M cumulative, the second largest in the presidential book, behind Lula's. On the eve the third-place book paid 47.50% for him, at 23:00 UTC on 03/Oct, and it was resolved in favour of Augusto Cury. 🤝 On the night of 04/Oct he said he backs neither of the two in the second round and freed Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil).

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: ELIMINATED IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema, with 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad did not run for President. PRICE: the three winner contracts were closed and resolved at zero.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) final tally (100% of polling sections) and the closing of the winner contracts after the first round.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 2.18% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.82M cumulative.
caiado.fortes: He promised to announce his endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro on Tuesday, 06/Oct, in Goiânia (Metrópoles and O Globo).
caiado.fracos: He finished fifth, behind Renan Santos, and the PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil).

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
haddad.fortes: The top of his series in the winner contract was 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He was not measured by any national poll in a presidential scenario or in a second-round pairing.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), eliminated in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) with 0.27% of the valid votes in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. His winner contract was closed and resolved at zero, with USD 7.74M cumulative.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured (O Globo).
zema.fracos: He had 0.27% of the valid votes. According to Folha de S.Paulo, Novo will declare support for Flávio Bolsonaro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution.

candidates.analise: 🗳️ Ronaldo Caiado finished the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in fifth, with 2.18% of the valid votes, and Romeu Zema had 0.27%, in the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally. Fernando Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for President. The three contracts in the winner book were closed by Polymarket and resolved at zero. 🤝 The PSD decided on neutrality in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) and freed its state branches (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil), and Ronaldo Caiado promised Flávio Bolsonaro he would announce his endorsement of him on Tuesday, 06/Oct, in Goiânia (Metrópoles and O Globo). According to Folha de S.Paulo, Novo, Romeu Zema's party, will declare support for Flávio Bolsonaro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado promised to announce his endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro on Tuesday, 06/Oct, in Goiânia (Metrópoles and O Globo).
⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of Romeu Zema's voters and 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) (O Globo).
fracos: The two are out of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), and the winner contracts of all three names were resolved at zero.
Fernando Haddad did not run for President: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

cruzamento: First day of the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno). 🗳️ In the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) final tally generated at 12:51 on 05/Oct, with 100% of polling sections, Flávio Bolsonaro has 47.03% of the valid votes and Lula 45.16%, followed by Augusto Cury, with 2.89%, Renan Santos, with 2.24%, and Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.18%. Abstention was 21.08% of the electorate, and blank and null votes came to 1.84% and 2.93% of the votes cast. The second round is on 25/Oct. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 05/Oct, 17:31 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro falls 1.15pp and Lula rises 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Oct at 21:43 BRT, published on the night of the count, and the gap goes from 68.75pp to 66.60pp. 📊 On the eve of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the second round was split: Lula ahead in Datafolha (47% to 46%), in CNT/MDA (47.3% to 43.1%) and in AtlasIntel (47.6% to 47.4%), a tie at 46% in PoderData, and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) (44% to 42%), in Palver (49% to 44%), in Futura (48% to 45.1%) and in Gerp (49% to 44%). 🤝 Renan Santos said on the night of 04/Oct that he backs neither of the two and frees Missão's activists to choose (Gazeta do Povo and Agência Brasil). The PSD decided on neutrality and freed its state branches (Folha de S.Paulo and Agência Brasil), and Ronaldo Caiado promised Flávio Bolsonaro he would announce his endorsement of him on Tuesday, 06/Oct, in Goiânia (Metrópoles and O Globo); as of this reading the announcement had not been made. União Brasil and PP signal support for Flávio Bolsonaro, with a decision in the coming days (Folha de S.Paulo and O Globo). According to Folha de S.Paulo, Novo, Romeu Zema's party, will declare support for Flávio Bolsonaro, and according to Agência Brasil Augusto Cury talks of staying silent in the second round; both reports have a single source and are included with attribution. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the result or to the endorsements: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
